test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are seven friends sitting in a single row facing North. S is to the immediate right of R. T and P are neighbours of U.Q is to the immediate left of R and on second place from left most end. P is at the right most end. Who is sitting on the immediate right of T?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are seven friends.

1) S is to the immediate right of R.

2) Q is to the immediate left of R and on second place from left most end.

3) T and P are neighbours of U.

4) P is at the right most end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09555c484d0df70e6685ff175c4e07fd1f626c188f54d2454a15abb4f05bbfea.png] 

So, **U** is sitting on the immediate right of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
